descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Ireland puts you in the captain's seat over the real Dublin, Dublin Bay and the Wicklow Mountains.

THE REAL DUBLIN
The Spire, the red and white Poolbeg chimneys, the Custom House, the GPO, the Four Courts, Trinity, Christ Church and St Patrick's, the Guinness Storehouse.

THE LIFFEY AND THE BAY
Fly low down the Liffey past its bridges - the Ha'penny and the Samuel Beckett harp - out past the lighthouses to Howth Head, Ireland's Eye and Dun Laoghaire.

A LIVING CITY
The DART round the bay, trains on their real tracks, traffic on the real roads, boats in the bay. At night the city and its bridges light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar in the Phoenix Park, the Wellington Monument through the doors. Repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
The city and Dublin Bay approaches, the Liffey Run, around the Poolbeg chimneys, the Howth coast, a Casement scramble, Dublin by night, a city tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
